description: Reads company setup and current equity subscription access from Stripe for a company reader. Read this before cap-table work and after the person returns from paying. Complete company proof before requesting a payment link. Where payment_required is true, continue cap-table work only when setup_complete and subscription_active are true. A link, paid_at receipt, or the person's claim of payment never proves current access. Errors mean access could not be checked; never treat them as paid or free.
name: equity_onboarding_get_subscription_access
title: Get Equity Subscription Access
